info.title: IfcIO - Pure Managed Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) CLI Tool
info.description: Fast, pure managed command-line tool for reading, converting, inspecting, and packaging Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) BIM models.

commands.name: bcf
commands.description:
Inspect buildingSMART BCF 2.1 zip archive topics, viewpoints, comments
view <file.ifc> [-o out.html] Export standalone 3D WebGL HTML viewer (.html)

commands.name: cost
commands.description: Inspect 5D cost schedule, budgets, takeoffs, and export CSV

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export model to glTF 2.0 (.glb), Wavefront OBJ (.obj), or re-encode IFC

commands.name: info
commands.description: Inspect IFC model metadata, spatial hierarchy, and geometry statistics

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Compress an .ifc physical file into a standard .ifczip archive

commands.name: patch
commands.description:
Apply cleanup, coordinate reset, or extraction recipes to an IFC model
export-csv <file> <out.csv> Export elements and properties to tabular CSV format
import-csv <file> <in.csv> -o <out.ifc> Update property sets from a CSV spreadsheet
clash <fileA> [fileB] Run 3D geometric clash detection (cross-model or self-clash)
diff <baseline> <rev> Compare two IFC model revisions (added, deleted, modified)

options.name: --recipe
options.description: Apply named patch recipe: migrate, scale, offset, purge, reset

options.name: --scale
options.description: Uniformly scale model geometry (e.g. 0.001 to convert mm to m)

options.name: --migrate
options.description: Migrate model schema version (ifc2x3 or ifc4)

options.name: --purge
options.description: Remove empty/duplicate property sets, quantity sets, and empty storeys

options.name: --reset-coords
options.description: Shift large UTM coordinates to local origin (0,0,0) to prevent jitter

options.name: --offset
options.description: Translate model geometry by given coordinate offset

options.name: --extract
options.description: Extract matching elements into a separate IFC model

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path for patched IFC model

commands.name: query
commands.description: Filter and inspect elements using IfcOpenShell-style selector expressions

commands.name: schedule
commands.description: Inspect 4D construction schedule, simulation progress, and export CSV

commands.name: unpack
commands.description: Extract the .ifc physical file from an .ifczip archive

commands.name: validate
commands.description:
Validate ISO 10303-21 STEP structure, header, and spatial relationships
validate-ids <file> <spec.ids> Validate model against buildingSMART IDS 1.0 XML specification
